overview.text: The company reported revenue of USD 24 million in Q2 2025, compared with USD 21 million in Q2 2024 (F1). Management attributed this increase to higher service subscriptions (F3).
Operating profit for Q2 2025 was USD 3 million (F2). The company held USD 7 million in cash as of 30 June 2025 (F4). No dividend was declared (F5).

highlights.text: Revenue grew from USD 21 million in Q2 2024 to USD 24 million in Q2 2025 (F1).
Management cited increased service subscriptions as the driver of higher revenue (F3).

The company did not declare a dividend (F5).
